# Disclos

> EU AI Act compliance for SaaS, three ways: a free tier for small businesses (free tools, no signup), live-site monitoring from 49 euro a month, and a human-led audit at 997 euro that includes a year of monitoring. The audit is five business days, with a refund if it does not get you ready for the wave deadline that applies to you.

Disclos is an independent research practice run by Gatis Ozols, registered in Latvia, focused only on Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. You can run the free tools yourself, subscribe to monitoring that watches your live site every week and tracks the obligations that apply to you, or buy a one-time human audit that maps your product clause by clause, returns copy and paste disclosure code, and includes a year of monitoring. Disclos is not a law firm and its reports are not legal advice. The Act arrives in three Omnibus waves: Article 50 transparency on 2 August 2026, Annex III high risk on 2 December 2027, and Annex I product safety on 2 August 2028.

## Three ways in

- Free for small businesses: a free tier you run yourself, no signup and no card. It includes a penalty calculator, an Annex III high-risk check, an Article 50 disclosure generator, a one-line SDK, a scope check, and two MCP servers for Claude and Cursor. Best for small teams, startups, and solo founders. All listed under Free tools below.
- Monitoring, from 49 euro a month: Disclos watches your live site every week and confirms the Article 50 disclosure is still present, scores your compliance out of 100, lets you register your AI features and auto-classifies them against the Act with an alert when a feature changes, and tracks every obligation that applies to you. Sign in at https://www.disclos.eu/login.
- Audit, 997 euro one time: a human reads the Act and your product, delivers a full readiness report in five business days, and includes twelve months of monitoring free.

## Services

- [Home](https://www.disclos.eu/): What Disclos does and which wave deadline applies to your product.
- [The audit](https://www.disclos.eu/audit): What the 997 euro audit delivers, from an AI feature map to a clause by clause gap report and ready disclosure code.
- [Pricing](https://www.disclos.eu/pricing): One flat price of 997 euro, charged once, refunded if you are not ready for your deadline.
- [Methodology](https://www.disclos.eu/methodology): The six stage process each audit runs, from intake brief to delivered report.
- [The law explained](https://www.disclos.eu/eu-ai-act): A plain reading of the EU AI Act for SaaS founders covering scope, duties, and deadlines.

## Free tools

- [Scope check](https://www.disclos.eu/check): A free assessment that shows which parts of the EU AI Act apply to your product.
- [Penalty calculator](https://www.disclos.eu/tools/penalty-calculator): Find the fine band your product sits in, by article.
- [Annex III triage](https://www.disclos.eu/tools/annex-iii-triage): A short questionnaire that tells you whether your system counts as high risk under Annex III.
- [Article 50 disclosure generator](https://www.disclos.eu/tools/article-50-disclosure-generator): Produces ready Article 50 disclosure wording for your product.
- [Developer tools and SDK](https://www.disclos.eu/developers): One line of script that shows the correct Article 50 AI notice to your visitors in all 24 EU languages, plus the MCP servers below. No signup, no key.

## MCP servers

- [Classifier MCP](https://mcp.disclos.eu): Returns the risk tier, the obligations, and the deadlines for an AI use case, each cited to the regulation.
- [Article 50 MCP](https://article50.disclos.eu): Returns Article 50 disclosure text in all 24 EU languages with copy and paste HTML.

## Articles

- [EU AI Act deadline calendar](https://www.disclos.eu/article/eu-ai-act-deadline-calendar): The three waves to 2028 and what each one asks of a SaaS product.
- [Using OpenAI does not make you compliant](https://www.disclos.eu/article/eu-ai-act-article-50-using-openai): Why a model provider does not carry your Article 50 duty for you.
- [MCP servers for the EU AI Act](https://www.disclos.eu/article/eu-ai-act-mcp-servers): How to call the Disclos classifier and Article 50 servers from Claude and Cursor.
